newsitem.title: USA: Remington Products sees drop in Q4 oper profit.
newsitem.headline: Remington Products sees drop in Q4 oper profit.

text.p: Remington Products Co LLC said Thursday that its fourth-quarter operating profit would decline from the year-earlier period, while sales would show little change.

Earlier Thursday, the company, which makes electric razors and other personal care products, reported preliminary results showing third-quarter operating profit had fallen to $4.5 million from $8.4 million in the 1995 third quarter.
Sales fell to $61.7 million from $66.5 million in the 1995 third quarter.
"Difficult operating conditions will likely continue to impact its U.S. domestic operations in the fourth quarter," the company said.
That will likely lead to little change in worldwide consolidated net sales for the fourth quarter and a decline in operating profit.

Remington said it was in compliance with all covenant provisions in its credit agreement. It "believes its current capital structure provides it with sufficient flexibility and liquidity to meet the company's near-term working-capital and debt-service requirements."
